rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an action is done with little strength or force.

example.english: They are walking weakly today because they are ill.
example.traditional: 佢今日病到行路都冇乜力咁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 beng6 dou3 haang4 lou6 dou1 mou5 mat1 lik6 gam3

rows.note: Use this when the action is deliberately gentle or light rather than forceful.

example.english: You weakly knock on the door so you do not wake anyone.
example.traditional: 你輕輕咁敲門，唔好嘈醒人。
example.jyutping: nei5 heng6 heng1 gam3 haau1 mun4 m4 hou2 cou4 sing2 jan4
